summary: Custom filament records (both freshly authored and those seeded from a decoded NFC tag) can never store nozzle or bed temperatures, directly contradicting the requirement to 'preserve temperatures ... for edited-catalog/custom records.'
claim: Custom filament records (both freshly authored and those seeded from a decoded NFC tag) can never store nozzle or bed temperatures, directly contradicting the requirement to 'preserve temperatures ... for edited-catalog/custom records.'

evidence.source: CustomRecord entity (data/Databases.kt) has columns only for brand/material/product/colorName/colorHex/diameterMm/massG/updatedAt — no nozzle/bed columns. CustomDialog's editable field list (MainActivity.kt) is exactly `listOf("Brand" to brand,"Material" to material,"Product" to product,"Color name" to color,"Color hex" to hex,"Diameter mm" to diameter,"Mass g" to mass)` — no temperature inputs exist. MainViewModel.saveCustom() constructs its validation-only FilamentRecord with nozzleMinC/nozzleMaxC/bedMinC/bedMaxC hardcoded to `null`. MainViewModel.decodedSeed() extracts brand/type/subtype/color_hex/diameter/weight from a decoded tag but never reads min_temp/max_temp/bed_min_temp/bed_max_temp, and CustomSeed has no temperature fields to carry them. CustomRecord.asCatalogEntry() (MainViewModel.kt) hardcodes nozzleMinC/nozzleMaxC/bedMinC/bedMaxC to null, so CatalogEntry.toRecord() (MainViewModel.kt) then omits them (`nozzleMinC?.let{...}`) from any subsequent OpenSpool write.

suggested_remediation: Add nozzle/bed temperature columns to CustomRecord (with a Room migration), add corresponding input fields to CustomDialog, populate them in decodedSeed()/CustomSeed, and thread them through saveCustom()/asCatalogEntry()/toRecord().
suggested_validation: Create a custom record with explicit nozzle 230–260 °C / bed 90–110 °C, kill and relaunch the process, confirm the values persist, then arm and encode it in both Canonical and PAXX profiles and confirm min_temp/max_temp/bed_min_temp/bed_max_temp appear in the resulting payload where the profile supports them.
reviewer_confidence: HIGH — derived directly from the full schema, UI, and mapping code with no external dependency.
